The bookcase has multiple shelves (approximately 6 visible levels) and appears to be made of light-to-medium stained wood. It is positioned against a plain wall. To the right, there is a small side table or stand with a dried plant arrangement.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible or nonsensical upon close inspection. Some spines show vague letter-like shapes that do not form real words, a common AI artifact in rendering dense text. However, from a distance, it mimics the visual texture of a library adequately.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner of the bookcase frame
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical stile on the bottom right seems to blend slightly into the shadow/wall area, lacking a crisp edge compared to the left side. It's subtle but suggests a slight boundary definition issue.
Some books appear to lean at physically improbable angles or merge slightly with adjacent books, lacking clear separation boundaries. This is minor but noticeable in the dense clusters.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a generic shelf or cabinet, verifying fine-grained features like material and proportion.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and ensure the books sit correctly on the planes without floating or merging into the back panel.
To check for edge bleeding between the bookcase and the wall, and to assess the separability of individual book spines which often fuse in AI generations.
To evaluate the overall realism, lighting consistency, and texture quality of the wood and paper materials.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric alignment of shelves (parallelism and orthogonality)
Boundary sharpness between the bookcase frame and the background wall
Physical plausibility of book stacking and leaning
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines. While they look like books from afar, AI often fails to render coherent text or distinct book edges. Check if the 'books' are actually just textured blobs fused together. Also, verify the vertical lines of the bookcase frame are straight and parallel, as perspective warping is common in generated furniture.
